title: MxAgile Project Status Projection 2
description: Deterministic, read-only projection of canonical MxAgile artifacts. Never a lifecycle authority. Missing or non-deterministic sources are represented as unavailable or null. No generated timestamp is included so identical inputs produce identical JSON.

projection_state.description: Server-side state of this disposable projection snapshot (Board only). Never project authority; STALE or BUILDING means the served snapshot may lag canonical sources.

source_fingerprint.description: Deterministic hash of the canonical source files read by this projection.

noncanonical_checklists.description: Checklists that exist as source files but are not canonicalized into Tasks (visible as such).

context.description: Durable values come from the last canonical context-epoch checkpoint. mode and current session pressure are unavailable unless separately attested; pressure is the recorded checkpoint value, not a live measurement.

source_references.description: Read-only deep-link inputs. canonical_path is repository-relative; clients construct local URLs and must never treat it as an arbitrary filesystem path.

delivery_assessment.description: DERIVED (delivery-assessment/v1). Never written back; each level carries evidence references or a reason.

current_work.description: DERIVED, never stored. Cascade: Mission -> registered active Wave -> next registered Wave -> none. Observed Git activity is reported, never attributed.

last_completed.description: Wave(s) whose phase changed to done in the most recent DONE transition (observed from the process-state history).

wave_trust.description: Trust in DONE. Historical lifecycle completion is separate from present evidence confidence.

changes_after_done.description: Later activity is reported beside DONE and never reopens or invalidates it. commit_count = commits after the DONE transition that touch artifacts explicitly linked to the Wave; project_activity_commits = project-wide delivery commits (not attributed).

observation_state.description: CS-3 closed vocabulary. NOT_RECORDED = project has not created the source; EMPTY = source readable with zero records; NOT_LOADED/LOADING = transient Board-internal; STALE = bound to an older fingerprint; INVALID = source exists but cannot be used; UNSUPPORTED = legacy/foreign form without projection rule; NOT_OBSERVABLE = structurally not determinable by the framework today; NOT_APPLICABLE = concept does not apply; AMBIGUOUS = conflicting sources; PROJECTION_ERROR = projection could not be built.

health.description: Derived projection/data health. Not project authority. Keeps project attention, projection health and framework diagnostics separate.

active_target_reference.description: A reference selected only by an accepted active revision or explicit UI-inventory target_mockup. It is not inferred from recency or filenames.

page_bindings.description: Logical Page IDs paired with their current mutable Mendix implementation names.

source_reference.description: A canonical artifact identity for local navigation; it is not a URL and grants no mutation authority.
